format.promptStyle: Plain English SD 1.x prompt, written as comma-separated descriptive phrases.
format.syntax: Plain text only. A1111 weighting, emphasis, and scheduling syntax is unsupported.
format.contentTokenLimit: Maximum 75 content tokens. The 77 CLIP positions include BOS and EOS; longer prompts are truncated.
format.indexing: Index 0 is the shared negative prompt; positive presets begin at index 1.
format.embeddingFiles: embedding-{index}.bytes, one file per catalog entry.
